title: Persuasive vs. Deceptive CO₂ Visualizations
description: DSC 106 Project 2. Built paired persuasive charts arguing for and against the claim that U.S. CO₂ emissions are no longer a growing climate problem, using U.S. emissions, trade, and fossil-fuel subsidy data in pandas and Plotly, and documented which design choices were earnest and which were deceptive.

title: GroceryDB Expository Visualization
description: DSC 106 Project 1. Designed a static expository visualization of GroceryDB with pandas and Plotly, examining how ultra-processed foods (NOVA classification) show up across the shelves, prices, and nutrition of major U.S. grocery stores.

title: Personal Portfolio Website
description: DSC 106 Labs. Built this site with semantic HTML, modern CSS (grid, subgrid, automatic dark mode), and JavaScript modules that render projects from a JSON file and pull live stats from the GitHub API.

title: LLM Fine-Tuning with LoRA & DoRA
description: Qualcomm Snapdragon Workshop. Trained a language model using the LoRA and DoRA parameter-efficient fine-tuning methods and compared their trade-offs for efficient model customization.

title: Lending Risk Detection
description: LPL Financial 4th Annual Hackathon. Designed and prototyped a lending risk detection system in a 24-hour team hackathon, integrating large language models with AWS cloud infrastructure.

title: Relational Database Analysis
description: DSC 100. Wrote and benchmarked 11 SQL queries in PostgreSQL against a ~1.15M-row flights dataset and the Chinook music-store database, then created indexes and compared query runtimes.

title: Project Gutenberg Web Scraper
description: DSC 80. Built a requests-based scraper for Project Gutenberg books that paces requests to respect robots.txt, using regular expressions to strip boilerplate and isolate each book's text.

title: Gradebook Data Processing System
description: DSC 80. Built a pandas grade calculator for heterogeneous assignment data with normalization, weighting, and redemption logic, validated against real course CSV data.

title: Graph Algorithms & Single-Linkage Clustering
description: DSC 40B. Implemented single-linkage clustering via Kruskal's algorithm with a disjoint-set forest, plus BFS/DFS routines for bipartite 2-coloring and weight-filtered connected components.

title: Image Processing Toolkit & KNN Classifier
description: DSC 20. Co-designed an object-oriented image processing toolkit in Python with an RGBImage class and inheritance-based transformations, and implemented a KNN image classifier from scratch.
